limitedSupport: Utanga isoko ntashobora gushyigikirwa byuzuye. Ubushobozi (ibikoresho, iyerekwa, amajwi) ntabwo byamenyekanye-ongeraho intoki intoki kandi ugene ubushobozi kuri buri cyitegererezo.
mlxExperimental: MLX inkunga ni igerageza. Ibishushanyo ntibishoboka, igitekerezo cyo guhinduranya ntikiracishwa, kandi bimwe mubyububiko bishya byubaka bishobora kunanirwa kwikorera. Tanga ibibazo kuri GitHub kugirango tubishyire imbere.
engineBundled: Moteri yumushinga yubatswe muri Novera, ntakintu rero cyo gukuramo cyangwa kuvugurura ukundi. Vuga iyi verisiyo mugihe utanga urugero rwananiwe kwikorera.
engineOtherVersion: Ukeneye verisiyo itandukanye llama.cpp? Koresha ibyawe llama-server hanyuma ubyongereho nkibisanzwe OpenAI utanga-utanga isoko.
refreshModelsError: Utanga agomba kuba afite base URL kandi byibura urufunguzo API rwashyizweho kugirango ruzane moderi.
noNewModels: Nta moderi nshya yabonetse. Moderi zose ziboneka zimaze kongerwaho.
refreshModelsFailed: Kunanirwa kuzana moderi kuva {{provider}}. Nyamuneka reba urufunguzo rwa API na base URL.
embeddingModelsDesc: Yakoreshejwe kuri RAG no gushakisha vector. Icyitegererezo cyatoranijwe gihinduka mugihe cyo kubyara.
importedTooltip: Yatumijwe muri dosiye yaho. Kubikura kuri Novera ntibisiba dosiye kuri disiki.
noModelFoundDesc: Moderi ziboneka zizashyirwa hano. Niba udafite icyitegererezo, sura Hub kugirango ukuremo.
noModelFoundRemoteDesc: Moderi ziboneka zizashyirwa hano. Koresha buto yo kugarura hejuru kugirango uzane moderi kubitanga, cyangwa ongeraho intoki hamwe na buto.

deleteModel.title: Gusiba Model: {{modelId}}
deleteModel.description: Uzi neza ko ushaka gusiba iyi moderi? Iki gikorwa ntigishobora gusubirwaho.
deleteModel.importedDescription: Kuraho iyi moderi yatumijwe muri Novera? Idosiye yawe yibanze kuri disiki ntizasibwa.
deleteModel.choiceDescription: Hitamo uburyo bwo kuvana iyi moderi muri Novera.
deleteModel.keepFilesDescription: Kuraho icyitegererezo kurutonde hanyuma ugumane dosiye zayo kuri disiki. Urashobora kongera gutumiza hanze.
deleteModel.permanentDescription: Siba icyitegererezo hamwe na dosiye yacyo Novera iyobowe na disiki. Ibi ntibishobora gusubirwaho.
deleteModel.permanentImportedDescription: Kandi usibe dosiye nkuru GGUF ahahoze. Amadosiye yubufasha yo hanze arabikwa. Ibi ntibishobora gusubirwaho.
deleteModel.removedSuccess: Model {{modelId}} yakuwe kuri Novera. Amadosiye yayo yarabitswe.

deleteAllModels.title: Gusiba moderi zose zakuweho?
deleteAllModels.description: Ibi bizakuraho burundu moderi (s) {{count}} muri disiki.
deleteAllModels.importedExcluded: {{count}} moderi (s) yatumijwe mu mahanga izabikwa (dosiye zabo ntizakuweho na Novera).
deleteAllModels.partialFailure: Kunanirwa gusiba {{count}} icyitegererezo (s). Reba konsole kubisobanuro birambuye.

deleteProvider.title: Gusiba Utanga
deleteProvider.description: Siba uyitanga hamwe na moderi zayo zose. Iki gikorwa ntigishobora gusubirwaho.
deleteProvider.confirmDescription: Uzi neza ko ushaka gusiba uyitanga? Iki gikorwa ntigishobora gusubirwaho.

editModel.title: Hindura Model: {{modelId}}
editModel.description: Hindura ubushobozi bwikitegererezo uhinduranya amahitamo hepfo.

warning.title: Komeza witonze
warning.description: Guhindura ubushobozi bwicyitegererezo bishobora guhindura imikorere nimikorere. Igenamiterere ritari ryo rishobora gutera imyitwarire itunguranye cyangwa amakosa.

baseUrl.title: Shingiro URL
baseUrl.azureDescription: Azure yawe OpenAI iherezo. Simbuza YOUR-RESOURCE-NAME nizina ryumutungo wawe wa Azure.
baseUrl.alibabaDescription: Koresha iherezo ryumwanya wawe wa Alibaba Cloud. Simbuza YOUR-WORKSPACE-ID n'umwanya wawe ukoreramo ID hanyuma ukoreshe urufunguzo API ruva mukarere kamwe.

apiKeys.title: API urufunguzo
apiKeys.description: Andika urufunguzo rwa API. Urashobora kongeramo urufunguzo rwinyongera muri Advanced, kandi Novera uzagerageza urundi rukurikira mugihe urufunguzo rwatsinzwe.
apiKeys.testHint: Kugenzura /models na buri rufunguzo kandi rukerekana kuri urufunguzo.
apiKeys.oneKeyHint: Urufunguzo rwo gusubira inyuma rwashyizweho muri Advanced.
